# `silk/compress/xz`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Decode XZ containers and verify their blocks, index, and footer.

## When to use
Use [`Xz.decode`](#Xz.impl.decode) for `.xz` files containing a single LZMA2 filter per block.

## Details
Supports concatenated streams, stream padding, multiple blocks, optional block sizes, and
none, CRC-32, CRC-64, or SHA-256 checks. Other filter chains are rejected. The caller supplies
output storage; probability tables allocate through the ambient allocator. Index records are
checked by scanning the already-validated block framing again, without allocating an index.

Import as `Xz` with `import silk.compress.xz { Xz }`.

### Associated function `decode`

```silk
pub effect fn decode(input: &[u8], output: &mut [u8], limits: DecodeLimits) -> Decoded
    ! OutOfMemoryError | DecodeError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Decodes complete XZ streams into the start of `output` and verifies container integrity.

#### Details
Accepts concatenated streams separated by multiples of four zero padding bytes. Each block
must use a single LZMA2 filter. Verifies header, block, index, and footer checksums; optional
block sizes; exact index records; and matching stream flags. Supports none, CRC-32, CRC-64,
and SHA-256 block checks. Probability tables allocate with the ambient allocator. The output
buffer holds dictionary history. Limits apply across all streams in the input.

#### Errors
`DecodeError` reports malformed or truncated data, invalid sizes or distances, checksum
mismatches, unsupported filters or checks, and input/output/dictionary/workspace limits.
Discard output after failure. `OutOfMemoryError` reports probability-table allocation failure.
